subject: SparkPoint go-live Handoff: owners, risks, and week-1 plan
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@sparkpointhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SparkPoint — ready for CS handoff

Hi Alex,

Great to see the DocuSign move — thanks for pushing that through. Per our final conversation, this note is the formal sales-to-CS handoff and includes the main artifacts the implementation team will need to get started.

Key deal/context:
- Product: Redwood Dedicated (VPC) + streaming generation API
- Committed capacity: 2x A40-equivalent GPUs, burst to 4 during ramp (monthly commit)
- Primary use: real-time patient triage summaries + internal clinical search (embeddings)
- Sensitive data posture: PHI scoped; customer requires VPC + KMS integration
- Go-live target: 2027-08-16 (tentative, contingent on network approvals)

Attachments (included):
- SOW-SparkPoint-v1.pdf (signed v1, pending final dates)
- Network-Requirements.xlsx (firewall & egress IPs)
- go-live-checklist.csv (acceptance gates)

Immediate asks for CS/Implementation team:
1) Please confirm primary CS owner and implementation lead by EOW (Fri 6/30).
2) Kick off an intro call with SparkPoint engineering (cc Taylor) for network walkthrough; request 60–90 minutes.
3) Review Network-Requirements.xlsx and flag any items that need procurement or third-party approvals — customer has strict change windows.

Internal notes: the procurement signature is set to clear today, but Alex called out a couple of firewall exceptions that will need 72h lead time. There is also a small request from legal around data retention that Marissa should own with Security.

Alex / Taylor — I’m looping in the CS team here so they can propose a go-forward activation plan and schedule. Marissa will be owning the customer relationship after handoff.

Next steps:
- Marissa: propose week-1 schedule by 6/30
- Karthik: confirm capacity-sizing and staging access needs
- Alex/Taylor: share contact for network ops (if different from Taylor)

Thanks,

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

[Attachment: SOW-SparkPoint-v1.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: Network-Requirements.xlsx (XLSX)]
[Attachment: go-live-checklist.csv (CSV)]

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@sparkpointhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Taylor Ng <taylor.ng@sparkpointhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SparkPoint — ready for CS handoff

Sean — thanks, and great to be moving. A few quick clarifications from our side before Marissa schedules things: 

- Confirm burst behavior: during peak clinic hours we expect short bursts; is automatic burst to 4 GPUs covered under the committed plan or billable overage?
- Staging environment: can you provision a staging instance with the same quantization profile as prod? We need to validate inference parity.
- Network change window: we can open a 4-hour change window, but it needs scheduling 72 hours in advance. Who do we send the formal change request to?

Also: legal has one small retention ask — can Redwood provide a data retention/erase spec for the VPC deployment? They want it in writing for our compliance pack.

I’m available Tue/Wed mornings for a 60-minute kickoff with the implementation team.

—Alex
Alex Rivera
Head of Integrations | SparkPoint Health
alex.rivera@sparkpointhealth.com
+1 (617) 555-4682

Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SparkPoint — ready for CS handoff (introductions & week-1 plan)

Hi Alex / Taylor — hi team, I’m Marissa and I’ll be the Customer Success lead for SparkPoint. Thanks Sean for the handoff. Looping Karthik and Vanessa for implementation and support.

High-level kickoff plan (proposed):
Week 0 (this week):
- Introductions + scope alignment call (60m) — proposed Tue 7/6 9:00am PT
- Network requirements review (Karthik & Taylor) — action: SparkPoint to provide ops contact and preferred change windows

Week 1 (initial setup):
- Provision staging environment (Karthik): 1–2 business days after network A/C
- Baseline tests: inference parity checks (small test set), embedding index sanity checks
- Security & compliance: deliver data retention spec and KMS key exchange plan (Vanessa will coordinate)

Owners & responsibilities:
- CS Lead: Marissa Cole (primary customer contact, escalation path)
- Implementation Lead: Karthik Iyer (network, staging, runbook execution)
- Support/Compliance: Vanessa Ortiz (KMS, audit logs, retention docs)

Risks & blockers we’ve flagged so far:
- Network change windows (needs 72h lead) — impacts staging timeline
- DocuSign finalization for SOW dates — pending signature date will set exact go-live week
- Legal retention ask — Vanessa will draft the retention/erase spec by 7/2

Request to SparkPoint: please confirm your preferred 60m slot (Tue 7/6 9am PT works for us) and share your network ops contact for formal change request. Also, please confirm when you can sign the DocuSign link (Sean — can you re-send if needed).

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
